
{{alias}}( document, pointer )
    Resolves a JSON Pointer against a document and returns the target
    container, key, and value.

    Per RFC 6901, an empty string refers to the root of the document.

    The `-` token on the last segment of a pointer targeting an array resolves
    to the array's length (past-the-end index).

    Tokens `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are rejected to prevent
    prototype pollution.

    Parameters
    ----------
    document: Object|Array
        JSON document.

    pointer: string
        JSON Pointer string.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object
        Result object.

    out.target: Object|Array|null
        Parent container. Null for root pointer.

    out.key: string|integer|null
        Final reference key. Null for root pointer.

    out.value: any
        Value at the pointer location.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( { 'foo': [ 'bar', 'baz' ] }, '/foo/0' )
    { 'target': [ 'bar', 'baz' ], 'key': 0, 'value': 'bar' }
    > out = {{alias}}( { 'foo': 'bar' }, '/foo' )
    { 'target': { 'foo': 'bar' }, 'key': 'foo', 'value': 'bar' }
    > out = {{alias}}( { 'foo': 'bar' }, '' )
    { 'target': null, 'key': null, 'value': { 'foo': 'bar' } }

    See Also
    --------
